covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SX-ORC-07, authored by muse-b2 as author of record (CB-0823 ORC subgroup) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/SX-ORC-07.check.md (seat B3, branch sx/core-loop, commit 53b0f9796). Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT — per-part closed forms (cad.mass-properties-brep's textbook forms) with material sources per part; the assembly CG in the test is computed independently from the part data. Behaviour: assembly mass is the sum of its parts with CG and the full inertia tensor rolled up about the assembly CG by parallel axis; a part whose material does not resolve is massless WITH its reason in outputs.masslessParts, excluded from totals and named in warnings — no stand-in density exists in the solver; a massive part without a position makes CG/inertia not-computed NAMING the part while the mass total still stands; contingency is a declared input in [0,1), absent = 0 echoed, never silent; over-budget is a WARN verdict with margin, not a solver failure; part positions are translations only, orientation out of scope and named. Dependencies named, not claimed: SX-CAD-03 (the per-part engine), SC-00 / SC-04 / SC-05 (helper used), SX-XC-01 fast-path labelling. Reviewer: at activation, confirm the discriminator transcript below still fails against the pinned pre-fix instance and bind packet_id.

steps: Via MCP conkay_solver_list (or the registry): orc.mass-bom is listed at L2.

Open a design whose node carries props["orc.mass-bom"] with budgetKg 7000 and two parts: a 1 m cube at density 6000 positioned at the origin, and a sphere of radius 1 in material "unobtanium" at [1,0,0] — envelope orc.mass-bom@<node> is WARN with outputs.totalMassKg == 6000, outputs.masslessParts naming the sphere part with the unresolvable-material reason, and outputs.budget.verdict == "within-budget". A total that includes any density for the sphere part FAILS this check.
Re-open with the cube's position removed — outputs.cgM is null and cgNotComputed names the cube part, while totalMassKg still stands.
title: orc.mass-bom: the assembly total is the sum of its parts, and the unresolvable part is massless with its reason — never a stand-in density
